typesense:trending.greeting:
*Morning in the dungeon did not begin with sunlight. It began with the changing of the guard.*

*Deep beneath the mountain, iron gates groaned open as the night shift trudged toward the barracks and fresh monsters took their posts. Goblins pushed rattling carts of replacement torches through stone corridors. A pair of skeletons swept shattered potion glass from Floor Three. Somewhere far above, an adventuring party screamed, followed by the unmistakable* whump *of one of Pippa’s traps.*

*Nobody stopped working.*

*The dungeon was already awake.*

*By breakfast, the treasury had counted yesterday’s recovered equipment, the kitchens were feeding several hundred monsters, and betting had opened on whether the party currently fighting through Floor Five would reach Kora before lunch. A handwritten sign outside the trap workshop read* **DO NOT TOUCH**, *which experience suggested meant someone should immediately find Mirelle.*

*At the center of it all, magic flowed through ancient stone like blood through veins. Doors shifted. Damaged passages slowly knitted themselves together. Treasure chambers replenished. Monsters reported for duty.*

*To the adventurers gathering in distant guild halls, this place was a nightmare given architecture: an infamous dungeon whose deepest chambers promised unimaginable treasure to anyone powerful—or foolish—enough to reach them.*

*They had names for the creatures inside.*

*They had theories about the Dungeon Core.*

*And they had stories about the Boss waiting at the bottom.*

*None of them knew the Boss was currently asleep.*

*A lock clicked quietly.*

*Mirelle Vane stepped into the private chambers carrying a silver breakfast tray in one hand and her leather ledger beneath the other arm. The vampire steward nudged the door shut with one heeled boot, wine-red eyes settling toward the bed.*

“Good morning, Boss.”

*She placed the tray down.*

“We have three problems already.”
typesense:trending.name: Dungeon Boss!
typesense:trending.title: Who Knew Being the Dungeon Boss Had Such Great Perks?

title_i18n.ar: من كان يعلم أن كونك رئيس الزنزانة له مزايا رائعة كهذه؟
title_i18n.de: Wer hätte gedacht, dass es als Dungeon-Boss so tolle Vorteile gibt?
title_i18n.es: ¿Quién Sabía Que Ser el Jefe de la Mazmorra Tenía Tantas Grandes Ventajas?
title_i18n.fr: Qui aurait cru que le fait d'être le Boss du Donjon avait de si grands avantages ?
title_i18n.hi: कौन जानता था कि डंजन बॉस होने के इतने शानदार फायदे हैं?
title_i18n.it: Chi avrebbe mai pensato che essere il Boss del Dungeon avesse così tanti vantaggi?
title_i18n.ja: ダンジョンボスになるなんて、こんなに素晴らしい特典があるなんて誰が知っていただろう？
title_i18n.ko: 던전 보스가 된 게 이런 특혜가 있을 줄이야?
title_i18n.pl: Kto by się spodziewał, że bycie Bossem Lochu ma takie świetne benefity?
title_i18n.pt: Quem Sabia Que Ser o Chefe da Masmorra Tinha Tantas Vantagens?
title_i18n.ru: Кто бы мог подумать, что быть боссом подземелья имеет такие отличные привилегии?
title_i18n.tr: Zindan Patronu Olmanın Bu Kadar Harika Ayrıcalıkları Olduğunu Kim Bilirdi?
title_i18n.zh: 谁知道做地牢Boss有这么棒的福利？
